Construction Materials Enabled.effect: 0 preserves Modes 0-26 exactly; 1 makes colonial expansion require both Capital Goods and Construction Materials.

Construction Materials Target Days.role: Construction Materials inventory target, days of desired demand.
Construction Materials Target Days.effect: Higher value raises desired stock coverage.

Construction Materials Adjustment Time.effect: Higher value slows production response to inventory gaps.

Construction Materials Buffer Days.role: Scale-free fulfillment buffer, days of demand.
Construction Materials Buffer Days.effect: Higher value lowers fulfillment for the same inventory coverage.

Regolith Target Days.role: Regolith target inventory, days of requirement.
Regolith Target Days.effect: Higher value raises raw-resource stock target.

Regolith Buffer Days.role: Scale-free Regolith availability buffer, days of requirement.
Regolith Buffer Days.effect: Higher value makes raw-resource limitation bind sooner.
